summary: The test compiles and runs, using correct Playwright APIs and including an assertion on URL change. However, the selector appears weak due to use of a generic data-test attribute without further validation, and the URL assertion is generic, lacking a precise validation of the product identifier or specific page content indicating the correct product detail page is rendered.

issues.description: Selector '[data-test="product-1"]' is a guess-based data attribute which may not remain stable or uniquely identify the intended product link.
issues.recommendation: Use more robust selectors or include test-specific stable attributes that uniquely identify UI elements.

issues.description: URL assertion with /product/ is too generic and does not confirm the specific product detail page loaded.
issues.recommendation: Enhance the URL assertion to include the product id or validate key content on the page to confirm the correct product detail page.

recommendations: Improve selector stability by using more specific attributes or locators tied to test identifiers.
Strengthen assertions by verifying unique page content or detailed URL patterns.
Consider adding assertions that validate visible product information on the detail page for stronger test coverage.
